use: A practical Roman military equipment maintenance rack

generator.prompt: A freestanding ancient Roman military equipment storage rack made of dark weathered oak. Exactly two plain oval wooden shields painted faded oxblood red lean against the lower horizontal rail, each with a small plain round bronze central boss. Two looped leather belts hang from the middle crossbar. The top rail is bare and empty. Thick square timber feet sit level on the ground. Clear simple open frame, practical hand-made construction, grounded painterly-realistic PBR wood grain and worn red paint. Compact isolated game prop, complete geometry from every side. No helmet, armour, head, people, weapons, inscriptions, logos, decorative platform or surrounding environment.
